hosts.inference: same machine as the client; loopback HTTP

other_gpus.name: AMD Raphael iGPU
other_gpus.role: display only, not used by the engine

hardware.storage: pack and model files on NVMe and on a 12.7 TB data volume; the engine streams experts from the GGUF

software.engine_build: source, SYCL AOT: cmake -S sycl -B build-sycl-aot -DSTRATA_SYCL_AOT=bmg-g31; ninja -j10

arms.description: the 0.2.11 release tree as previously deployed on this host
v0.2.12 plus our local work on top of it (the tree serving port 8095's tests); the version comparison below is a build check, not a claim about a release

arms.label: 0.2.12-stock
arms.description: unmodified v0.2.12 (tag 146df3c46), same source build options

model.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO (Coder) IQ1_M
model.sha256: not measured (54.5 GiB over two shards; the files were not rehashed for this report)
model.expert_profile: data/expert-profile-mine.bin (engine calibration output, produced on this host)

configuration.changed_settings_between_arms: none: the three arms ran the same config file and the same command line

method.client: loopback HTTP, one request at a time, streaming
method.sampling: temperature 0 for the comparison lanes (deterministic), no reasoning_effort override
method.interleaving: six engine windows in the order f11,f12,s12,f11,f12,s12; each window runs warm-up, fresh 4.2k, fresh 8.8k, follow-up 4.4k, follow-up 9.1k, a 32-token code prompt, a 30k-token prompt (1-token cap, prompt time only), a 7,855-token needle, and an over-window request
method.totals: 24 measured requests per arm window pair; medians over 2 windows x 2 repetitions per lane
method.engine_timings: prefill_tps = prompt_n/prompt_ms, decode_tps = predicted_n/predicted_ms from the answer's timings block; wall_s is the client's
